summary: First is this simple power of good visualization tools to help untangle complexity  and just encourage you to ask questions you didn't think of before.

For example, you could plot the flow of carbon through a corporate supply chain  in a corporate ecosystem or the interconnections of habitat patches  for endangered species in your semi-national park.

The next thing is that if you want to predict the effect of one species on another,  if you focus on only that link and then you black-box the rest,  it's actually less predictable than if you step back,  consider the entire system, all these pieces, all the links,  and from that place hone in on the sphere of influence that matters most.
